Name: BackTop Purpose
Description: 返回页面顶部的操作按钮

Name: BackTop Scenario
Description: 当容器滚动到一定高度的时候在右下角会出现一个返回顶部的按钮

Name: BackTop Behavior
Description: 点击按钮平滑滚动到页面顶部

Name: Type Primary
Description: 蓝色背景的主要返回顶部按钮

Name: Type Default
Description: 白色背景带边框的默认返回顶部按钮

Name: Type Custom
Description: 支持自定义内容的返回顶部按钮

Name: Position Fixed
Description: 返回顶部按钮固定定位

Name: Primary Hover Background
Description: 主要类型悬停深蓝色背景

Name: Primary Active Background
Description: 主要类型激活深蓝色背景

Name: Default Hover Background
Description: 默认类型悬停白色背景

Name: Default Hover Border
Description: 默认类型悬停蓝色边框

Name: Default Hover Color
Description: 默认类型悬停蓝色图标

Name: Button Cursor
Description: 返回顶部按钮可点击光标

Name: Button Transition
Description: 返回顶部按钮过渡动画0.2s

Name: Icon Type
Description: 返回顶部使用向上箭头图标

Name: Icon Color Inherit
Description: 图标颜色继承按钮颜色

Name: Visibility Threshold
Description: 滚动超过400px显示返回顶部按钮

Name: Visibility Default
Description: 默认隐藏返回顶部按钮

Name: Show Animation
Description: 返回顶部按钮淡入动画

Name: Hide Animation
Description: 返回顶部按钮淡出动画

Name: Mobile Size
Description: 移动端按钮44px满足触摸目标
